title: Present Perfect: Just, Already, Yet
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Ya dominas cómo hablar sobre acciones recientes o completadas en el trabajo.

parts.visual: Usamos JUST para decir que algo pasó hace un momento (acaba de pasar). Se pone entre el 'have/has' y el verbo. Ej: I have JUST sent the email (Acabo de enviar el correo).
parts.audio: We use JUST to say that something happened a moment ago. It goes between 'have' or 'has' and the main verb. For example: I have JUST sent the email.

parts.visual:
ALREADY = Ya (para acciones que pasaron antes de lo esperado). Va en medio. Ej: I have ALREADY finished the report (Ya terminé el reporte). 
YET = Todavía no / ¿Ya? (Se usa al final en negativas y preguntas). Ej: I haven't finished YET (Todavía no termino). Have you finished YET? (¿Ya terminaste?).
parts.audio: ALREADY means 'ya', for actions that happened sooner than expected. It also goes in the middle. Example: I have ALREADY finished the report. YET means 'todavía no' in negatives, or 'ya' in questions. It goes at the end. Examples: I haven't finished YET. Have you finished YET?

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige Just, Already o Yet para completar la frase en Present Perfect.

questions.question: I have ____ sent the email. (Hace 1 minuto / Acabo de).
questions.explanation: 'Just' indica una acción muy reciente (acabo de).

questions.question: I have ____ booked the flight. You don't need to do it. (Ya lo hice).
questions.explanation: 'Already' indica que algo ya se hizo (antes de lo esperado).

questions.question: I haven't finished the presentation ____. (Todavía no).
questions.explanation: 'Yet' se usa al final de oraciones negativas para decir 'todavía no'.

questions.question: Have you signed the contract ____? (¿Ya lo hiciste?).
questions.explanation: En preguntas al final, 'yet' significa '¿ya?'. ¿Ya firmaste el contrato?

questions.question: The CEO has ____ arrived. He is in the lobby. (Acaba de).
Don't worry, I have ____ paid the invoice. (Ya).
We haven't received the payment ____. (Todavía no).
questions.explanation: Yet al final de frase negativa.

questions.question: Are they here? - Yes, they have ____ walked in. (Acaban de).
questions.explanation: Just walked in = acaban de entrar.

questions.question: Has she replied to your email ____?
I don't need to read it. I have ____ read it twice. (Ya).
questions.explanation: Already = ya (antes de lo que pensabas).

questions.question: We have ____ launched the new product! It went live 5 minutes ago.
The IT team hasn't fixed the problem ____. (Todavía no).
Can you call him? - I have ____ spoken to him. (Ya lo hice).
I've ____ finished lunch. Give me 10 minutes to digest. (Acabo de).
Have they approved the budget ____?
We ____ just closed the deal! (Auxiliar).
She ____ already left the office. (Auxiliar).
I haven't ____ the report yet. (Escribir - Participio).
He has just ____ me a message. (Enviar - Participio).
They have already ____ the new manager. (Contratar - Participio).
I have ____ sent it. (Acabo de)
I have ____ finished. You don't need to help. (Ya)
I haven't finished ____. (Todavía)
Have you signed it ____? (¿Ya?)
He has ____ left. He was here a minute ago. (Acaba de)
We have ____ paid the invoice. Don't worry. (Ya)
They haven't called ____. (Todavía)
Have they arrived ____?
I have ____ started the meeting. Join now! (Acabo de)
I know, I have ____ read the email. (Ya lo sé / Ya lo leí)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I have just sent the email.
options: I have just sent the email.
I have already sent the email.
I haven't sent the email yet.
I sent the email just now.
questions.correct_answer: I have just sent the email.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I have already booked the flight.
options: I have already booked the flight.
I have just booked the flight.
I haven't booked the flight yet.
questions.correct_answer: I have already booked the flight.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I haven't finished the presentation yet.
options: I haven't finished the presentation yet.
I have already finished the presentation.
I haven't finished the report yet.
questions.correct_answer: I haven't finished the presentation yet.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Have you signed the contract yet?
options: Have you signed the contract yet?
Have you already signed the contract?
Did you sign the contract yet?
Have you read the contract yet?
questions.correct_answer: Have you signed the contract yet?

questions.question: Listen carefully.

questions.tts_text: I have already paid the invoice.
options: I have already paid the invoice.
I have just paid the invoice.
I haven't paid the invoice yet.
questions.correct_answer: I have already paid the invoice.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We haven't received the payment yet.
options: We haven't received the payment yet.

questions.correct_answer: Has she replied to your email yet?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I have just closed the deal.
